note: Shadow Shiv: she dashes to the target (frame 1, the sprint, travels from home; the page adds a violet streak), plants her front foot (2), stabs on the hit frame (3), slides back in the plant pose (4) and is home in the idle stance (5). x is a share of the way to the strike point (1 = 0.8 character widths in front of the target); 12 fps makes the whole skill 0.42 s.
